bright-izar.physicalScope: Baines et al. 2025 Tables 6-7 supersedes the heterogeneous older temperature/radius/luminosity. Radius scales as distance and luminosity as distance squared from source parallax 13.83 mas to the shared Hipparcos distance. Temperature 4341 +/-39 K is distance independent; source radius +1.30/-1.39 Rsun and luminosity 459 Lsun are retained verbatim. Shared parallax uncertainty is correlated across distance-scaled quantities; the printed 0.1 Lsun source error is not a complete luminosity error. Published seismic mass 5.36 +/-0.48 Msun (Rudrasingam 2026) retains its original 4755 K /37.61 Rsun assumptions and scaling systematics; it is not a dynamical mass or recalculated here.
